news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Revenue is less than US$1m (₹43m revenue, or US$462k). news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price decline to ₹2.99, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 5.6x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Food industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 61% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.04 loss per share (vs ₹0.05 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.04 loss per share (improved from ₹0.05 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.95m (down 77% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹1.38m (loss narrowed 13% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has fallen by 27% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.23 (vs ₹0.22 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.23 (up from ₹0.22 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹13.7m (down 82% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.03m (up 5.9% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 59% (up from 10% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 9% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 29% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
